blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In search engines and assistants, long-form RAG answers can mislead readers with claims their sources do not support. Faithfulness rewards, the share of supported sentences, train models toward fewer such claims. We show that these rewards are hacked by copying. A sentence copied from the passages is supported almost by construction, so trained models learn to copy rather than ground what they write. Common defenses only move the hack: a KL or copy penalty leaves copying in place or trades it for shorter, emptier answers and refusals. GRPO, the standard RL algorithm, makes it worse by giving every sentence its answer's advantage, reinforcing copied and grounded sentences alike. We propose Authored-Sentence Credit (ASC) , which fixes both by moving GRPO's reward and advantage from the answer to the sentence level. The reward credits only sentences that are authored rather than copied, say more than the question, and are supported by the passages. The advantage compares each sentence with every sentence sampled for the question, so one that earns no credit ranks last and is never reinforced. Across four models and two in-domain, three held-out corpora, only ASC lowers the error rate of authored sentences and writes more supported ones in every setting, by 38% and 46% at the median under held-out evaluators, giving readers more grounded information. It takes none of these shortcuts, and two LLM judges comparing whole answers prefer no baseline to the base model but rate ASC's answers on par with it. We conclude that a faithfulness reward should credit what a model writes, not what it copies.
blocks.zh: 在搜索引擎和助手中,长式RAG答案可以误导读者,声称其来源不支持. 忠诚的奖励, 支持的判刑份额, 训练模型 减少这种主张。 我们显示这些奖赏是通过抄袭黑入的. 从段落中抄取的句子几乎得到了构造的支持,因此训练有素的模型学会了抄写而不是将所写的东西地面. 普通防守只移动黑客:一KL或复制罚让复制到位或交易,以缩短,更空洞的答案和拒绝. GRPO,标准RL算法,通过给每个句子以答案的优势,同时强化被复制和被基于的句子,使其更加糟糕. 我们提出授权-常识信用(ASC), 赏罚记分只写出而非抄录的句子,多说出出问题来,得到段落的支持. 优势是将每个句子与每个被抽取的句子相提并论,因此一个没有获得信用排名的句子是最后的,并且从未被强化. 在四个模型和两个域内,三个被搁置的公司,只有ASC降低作者句子的出错率,并在每个设定中写出更多得到支持的句子,在被搁置评价员的中位数下分别上升了38%和46%,为读者提供了更有根据的信息. 它不需要这些快捷键,两个LLM评委比较整个答案都不喜欢基准模型,而是对ASC的答案进行等价评分. 我们的结论是,忠诚的奖励应该归功于一个模型写的东西,而不是它复制的东西。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Retrieval-augmented generation ( Lewis et al., 2020 , RAG;) now answers open questions in search engines and assistants, yet its long-form answers often state claims their sources do not support, in web search ( Liu et al., 2023 ) as in law and medicine ( Magesh et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
Faithfulness, the share of an answer’s sentences a checker finds supported by the passages ( Gao et al., 2023b ; Min et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2024 ) , is now a training signal against such claims, as a reward for reinforcement learning or to rank preference pairs ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
被检索的一代(Lewis等人,2020年;RAG;;)现在在搜索引擎和助手中解答了未解的问题,然而其长式的答案往往声称其来源不支持,在网络搜索中(Lew等人,2023年)和在法律和医学中(Magesh等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年).
忠诚(Faithity),一个检查者发现有段落支持的答案的句子份额(Gao等,2023b;Min等,2023;Tang等,2024),现在是反对这种主张的训练信号,作为对强化学习的奖励或对偏好对等的分级(Huang等,2024;Chen等,2026;Tian等,2024).

blocks.en:
The reward has a cheaper way up.
A sentence copied from the passages is supported almost by construction: on ASQA, the sentences Qwen3.5-9B writes itself are unsupported 3.7 times as often as those it copies, and those of Llama-3.1-8B 3.2 times (Figure 1 a).
The reward therefore rises with every sentence a model copies instead of writing.
blocks.zh:
赏金有更便宜的方法
从段落中复制的一句几乎得到了构造的支持:在ASQA上,Quen3.5-9B的句子本身是其复制的3.7倍,而Llama-3.1-8B的句子是3.2倍(图1a)的不支持.
因此,奖赏随着每一句句而增加,就是模范拷贝而不是写作。

blocks.en:
Trained policies exploit this gap, a form of reward hacking ( Skalse et al., 2022 ) .
GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) raises the copy share of Qwen3.5-9B from 38.8 to 72.8 (Figure 1 b) and shrinks its answers from 74 to 14 words: the reward climbs because the model stops writing, not because it grounds better.
Common defenses only move the hack between three shortcuts (copying, writing less and writing emptier sentences): on the same model, a KL penalty holds copying at the base level, but refusals more than double and answers grow shorter and emptier, and a copy penalty makes it decline most questions.
GRPO itself makes it worse: it gives every token of an answer the same advantage, its update weight, so a copied or empty sentence in a high-reward answer is reinforced and a grounded one in a low-reward answer pushed down.
blocks.zh:
训练有素的政策利用这一差距,这是一种奖励黑客形式(Skalse等,2022年).
GRPO(Shao等,2024年)将Qun3.5-9B的拷贝份额从38.8升至72.8(图1b)并收缩了答案从74个字到14个字:奖励攀升是因为模型停止了写作,而不是因为它的根据更好.
常见的防御只将黑客移动到三个捷径(复制,写作较少和写作更空的句子)之间:在同一模式下,一个KL处罚在基数级别上会进行复制,但拒绝的比双倍多,答案会变短而更空,一个副本处罚使得它拒绝大多数问题.
GRPO本身更是雪上加霜:它给每个回答的符号都带来同样的优势,它的更新重量,因此在高回报的回答中,一个被复制的或空的句子被加固,一个被低回报的回答被推倒了.

blocks.en:
We propose Authored-Sentence Credit ( ASC ), to our knowledge the first faithfulness reward that pays only for what the model writes itself (Figure 4 ).
It changes GRPO in two places and adds no model.
Its reward credits a sentence only if it is not copied, says more than the question (not vacuous ), and is supported by the passages.
Its advantage scores each sentence against all sentences sampled for the question, so each sentence is judged by its own credit, not its answer’s.
Together, they guarantee that a copied, vacuous or unsupported sentence ranks last in its group and is never reinforced.
blocks.zh:
据我们所知,我们提出“授权的存款”(ASC),这是第一个只支付模型本身所写内容的忠诚奖励(图4)。
它在两个地方修改了GRPO,没有添加模型.
它的奖励只有在没有被抄袭的情况下才会得到一个句子,说得比问题(不是空洞)还要多,并且得到段落的支持.
其优势是将每个句子与所有为问题抽样的句子进行比对,因此每个句子都是根据自己的功劳而不是答案来判断的.
它们共同保证,抄袭的、空洞的或不支持的句子排在其组中最后,并且永远不会被强化。

blocks.en:
We train four models from two families on two corpora and test them on five, three held out.
Every baseline, even a sentence-level reward, lowers the error rate of authored sentences at the median, yet takes a shortcut in nearly every setting. ASC alone lowers it while writing more, with no shortcut in any setting: at the median, it cuts that error rate by 38% under an independent judge and writes 46% more supported sentences of its own, giving readers more grounded information; human annotators confirm the drop without the judge.
A higher reward alone does not give better answers: every baseline raises the reward, yet two LLM judges comparing whole answers prefer none to the base model but rate ASC on par with it and above every baseline.
blocks.zh:
我们训练两个家庭的4个模型 在两只蝎子上,测试它们 5,3坚守。
每个基线,甚至一个句子级别的奖励,都会降低中位数的写出句子出错率,然而在几乎每个设置中都会有一个快捷键. ASC在写更多时会降低它,在任何场合都没有任何捷径:在中位数下,它会将这个出错率在独立法官下削减了38%,并自己写46%的支持句子,给读者更多的有根据的信息;人类的注释员在没有法官的情况下确认掉落.
单靠更高的报酬并不能给出更好的答案:每个基线都提高报酬,然而,两个LLM法官比较整个答案都不喜欢基准模型,而是将ASC评分与基准相当,并高于每个基线。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows. • Analysis. We show that faithfulness rewards pay for copying, that KL and copy penalties only move the hack to other shortcuts, and that GRPO’s answer-level advantage barely tells copied from grounded sentences. • Method. We propose ASC , to our knowledge the first faithfulness reward that credits only authored sentences, and prove that no uncredited sentence is ever reinforced. • Results. Only ASC lowers the authored error rate and writes more supported sentences in all settings, with no shortcut and no quality loss.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献如下。 • 分析。 GRPO的解答水平优势几乎无法说明抄袭内容。 • 方法。 我们提议ASC, 据我们所知,第一个忠诚的奖赏 只能是写作的判决, 并证明任何不可信的判决 从来没有得到加强。 • 结果。 只有 ASC 降低了作者出错率,并在所有设置中写出更多支持的句子,没有快捷键,也没有质量损失.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Faithfulness metrics favor copying. Long-form answers are scored statement by statement against their sources ( Gao et al., 2023b ; Min et al., 2023 ) , and small checkers make this scoring cheap enough to serve as a reward ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Zha et al., 2023 ) .
In summarization, such metrics favor extractive output, so faithfulness gains often come from copying ( Ladhak et al., 2022 ; Dreyer et al., 2023 ) , and an entailment reward can trade informativeness for consistency ( Roit et al., 2023 ) .
We study this bias as a reward hack in long-form RAG, where copying has a cost for readers: in generative search, more precise citations come with more copying from the sources and lower perceived utility ( Liu et al., 2023 ) .
Trivially true claims also inflate factuality scores ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) ; our vacuity test removes them by checking each sentence against the question alone, as context-contrast methods do ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Cohen-Wang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
忠诚的衡量标准有利于复制。 Long-form answers 逐个声明,对照其来源(Gao等,2023b;Min等,2023),而小检查者使这个分数变得便宜到足以作为奖励(Tang等,2024;Zha等,2023).
总而言之,这种衡量标准有利于采掘产出,因此,忠实收益往往来自复制(Ladhak等人,2022年;Dreyer等人,2023年),而一项必然的奖励可以用来换取一致性(Roit等人,2023年)。
我们研究这种偏见作为长式RAG的奖励黑客, 复制给读者带来成本:在基因搜索中,

blocks.en:
Grounded generation and reward hacking. Faithfulness and factuality objectives train models through preference optimization ( Tian et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2025 ) , reinforcement learning ( Si et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) , self-reflection ( Asai et al., 2024 ) and citation tuning ( Ye et al., 2024 ) , and one method even trains RAG models to copy more so that they hallucinate less ( Long et al., 2026 ) .
Optimizing such a proxy invites reward hacking ( Skalse et al., 2022 ; Gao et al., 2023a ) , best studied for length ( Singhal et al., 2024 ) ; for factuality, precision-only metrics and rewards favor short, less detailed answers ( Wei et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
A KL penalty does not prevent hacking under heavy-tailed reward error ( Kwa et al., 2024 ) , and optimization amplifies a reward’s biases ( Shapira et al., 2026 ; Moya et al., 2026 ) .
We show that faithfulness rewards are hacked by copying, and that common defenses only move the hack.
blocks.zh:
基地生成和奖励黑客。 忠诚与事实目标 通过优化偏好(Tian等,2024;Song等,2025),强化学习(Si等,2025;Huang等,2024),自我反射(Asai等,2024)和引用调取(Ye等,2024),还有一种方法甚至培训RAG模式以复制更多,使其产生较少的幻觉(Long等,2026).
优化这样的代理邀请奖励黑客(Skalse等,2022;Gao等,2023a),最能研究长度(Singhal等,2024;事实性,精准度量和奖励偏好短而不太详细的答案(Wei等,2024;Chen等,2026).

我们显示忠诚的奖励是通过复制黑客, 而普通的辩护只移动黑客。

blocks.en:
Fine-grained credit assignment. Dense signals score each sentence ( Wu et al., 2023 ) or reasoning step ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) .
GRPO normalizes rewards within a group of answers ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , and GiGPO within groups of steps ( Feng et al., 2025 ) .
The closest rewards score facts or sentences for closed-book correctness ( Wen et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2025 ) or for support in RAG ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , but none asks whether a sentence was copied. ASC withholds credit from copied and vacuous sentences and compares sentences, not answers, so these are never reinforced.
blocks.zh:
精细的信用分配。 腾讯信号每句得分(Wu等,2023)或推理步骤(Lightman等,2024).
GRPO在一组答案(Shao等,2024年)和GIGPO在一组步骤(Feng等,2025年)中实现奖励正常化。
最贴近的奖赏得分的事实或判罚为封闭本的正确性(Wen等,2025;Gu等,2025)或支持为RAG(Huang等,2024),但没有人问一句是否抄袭. ASC对抄袭和空闲的句子扣下信用,并比较了句子,而不是答案,因此这些句子从未被强化.

Finding 1: copied sentences are rarely unsupported, so the reward pays for copying. We sample eight answers per question from each base model on ASQA, RAGTruth, ClapNQ and ELI5.
Under the reward’s checker, authored sentences are unsupported 2.3 to 4.4 times as often as copied ones on average (Figure 2 a), and more often for every model and corpus.
The gap is not an artifact of the checker: two held-out checkers find it almost everywhere, and so do human labels on RAGTruth’s responses, 12.2% against 1.9% (Figure 2 b).
With s c s_{c} and s a s_{a} the support rates of copied and authored sentences, the reward of Eq. 1 decomposes as R = s a + ρ ⁡ ( s c − s a ) , \textstyle R\;=\;s_{a}\;+\;\rho\,(s_{c}-s_{a}), (2) a line in ρ \rho with slope s c − s a > 0 s_{c}-s_{a}>0 : at fixed authored reliability, every sentence copied instead of written raises R R (proof in Appendix A.1 ).
Sampled answers agree: among answers to the same question, those that copy more earn more reward for every model and corpus (slopes in Appendix C.1 ).
Yet a copied sentence inherits its source’s reliability, so its credit says nothing of the model’s own grounding.
This gives the first requirement, (R1) : a copied sentence earns nothing, however well supported.

blocks.en:
Finding 2: training takes the shortcuts, and common defenses only move between them. We train Qwen3.5-9B to raise R R with GRPO, alone or with one of two defenses, a KL penalty ( Ziegler et al., 2020 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ) or a copy penalty, and with DPO (Table 1 ).
Plain GRPO nearly saturates the reward (98.9) through the cheapest shortcuts, and the answers get worse: copy share nearly doubles within half of training, answers shrink from 74 to 14 words (Figure 3 ), and exact match falls from 45.5 to 27.6.
Each defense closes one shortcut and opens another: the KL penalty holds copying at the base level, but answers grow shorter and emptier and refusals rise, and the copy penalty cuts copying, but its vacuous share rises to 67.4% and it declines 64.5% of questions.
DPO copies too, even on pairs whose answers copy nearly equally: preferring better-supported answers alone pulls it toward the passages.
The two penalties take a shortcut on nine in ten model–corpus pairs (grey in Table 2 ). R R pays for any sentence the checker cannot reject, so penalizing one quantity only reroutes the optimizer.
This gives the second requirement, (R2) : a vacuous sentence earns nothing, and dropping sentences or refusing never pays.

Plain GRPO几乎通过最便宜的捷径来饱和奖励(98.9),答案会变得更糟糕:在训练的一半时间里,拷贝分享近一倍,答案从74到14个单词收缩(图3),准确匹配从45.5到27.6.

blocks.en:
Finding 3: GRPO’s advantage barely tells a copied sentence from a grounded one. GRPO’s advantage belongs to the whole answer, so a sentence is rewarded for the answer it sits in: a copied or vacuous sentence in a high-reward answer is pushed up, and a grounded one in a low-reward answer is pushed down.
Copying therefore barely changes a sentence’s chance of being reinforced: on Finding 1’s samples, of the sentences GRPO moves, it pushes up 72.0% of the copied ones and 75.5% of the grounded ones, and even 58.8% of the vacuous ones; grounded ones are pushed up more often everywhere, but by at most 17 points (Appendix C.3 ).
An answer-level advantage thus cannot steer the policy away from copying: it reinforces whatever the high-reward answers contain.
This gives the third requirement, (R3) : sentences are compared with sentences, so that each advantage reflects the sentence’s own reliability.
blocks.zh:
GRPO的优势几乎不能说明有底句抄袭。 GRPO的优势属于整个答案,因此一个句子会因它所坐的答案而得到回报:一个被抄袭或空虚的句子在高回报的答案被推上,一个被打入低回报的答案被推下.
因此,抄袭几乎没有改变一个句子被强化的可能性:在1号样本中,GRPO移动的句子将72.0%被抄袭的句子和75.5%被抄袭的句子,甚至58.8%被抄袭的句子;被抄袭的句子在任何地方被推高的频率都更高,但最多只有17分(附录C.3)。
因此,答案层次的优势不能使政策避免复制:它强化了高回报答案中的任何内容。
这给出了第三项要求,即(R3):判决与判决作比较,以便每个优势都反映判决本身的可靠性.

blocks.en:
Only ASC lowers the error rate while writing more. Every method lowers the authored error rate at the median, ASC the most (38%, against 31 to 36%), but a model can also lower it by writing less, so Err alone does not separate them (Table 2 ).
What separates them is how much grounded content the model still writes (Supp.): ASC writes the most supported authored sentences on every model, 46% more than the base model at the median and more in every setting, whereas GRPO + KL writes fewer than the base model on three of the four models.
The lower rate is not a dilution by the extra sentences: unsupported authored sentences per answer fall too, in 16 of the 20 settings.
Figure 5 shows that the cut holds at every error level, including the hardest settings, where the base model errs on about 40% of its sentences.
It is even larger on the held-out corpora, never seen in training, than in domain (median 38% against 32%).
blocks.zh:
只有ASC在写更多时会降低出错率. 每一种方法都降低了作者在中位数上的出错率,ASC最多(38%,相对于31-36%),但一个模型也可以通过写得更少来降低它,因此仅Err本身并不能将它们分开(表2).
他们的区别在于这个模型仍然写着多少内容(Supp. ASC在每个模型上写出最受支持的作者句子,比中位数的基础模型多出46%,在每个设置中则多出,而GRPO + KL在四个模型中的三个上写出比基础模型少出.
更低的速率不是被额外句子所淡化的:没有支持的作者每回答句也掉入了20个设置中的16个.
图5显示,剪接在每一个出错级别,包括最难的设置,其中基数模型在大约40%的句子上误差.
在被扣留的公司中,培训中从未见过的这种比例甚至大于域(中间值为38%对32%)。

blocks.en:
ASC takes no shortcut; the baselines take one almost everywhere. In every setting ASC copies less than the base model, writes fewer vacuous sentences and refuses less often, so none of its Err values is grey in Table 2 , under any margin from 1 to 10 points.
The baselines buy their lower error rates with a shortcut, and closing one opens another, as in Finding 2: GRPO + KL declines up to 43.9% of questions on the Qwen models, against about 5% before training, and copies more on the Llama models; the copy penalty cuts copying but declines 79.7% of questions on Qwen3.5-9B; and the sentence reward copies more than the base model in every setting, since scoring sentences one by one does not close the copy shortcut.
Where a baseline takes no shortcut (5 of 60), its error rate is never significantly below ASC ’s, and ASC writes significantly more supported authored sentences in all five, so no baseline matches it even there.

blocks.en:
ASC gains faithfulness at no cost in quality. Two LLM judges, Gemma-4-31B and Mistral-Small-3.2-24B ( Mistral AI, 2025 ) from a third model family, pick, in both orders, the answer that serves a reader better, under a rubric fixed on base-model probes before any trained answer was judged, to favor neither copied text nor padded answers (Appendix E ).
For every baseline the faithfulness gains cost quality (Table 3 ): each raises the reward over the base model, yet neither judge prefers any of them to it. ASC is the only method that pays nothing: both judges rate its answers on par with the base model’s while they carry fewer errors and more supported sentences, and prefer them to those of every baseline.
Blind human annotators, with the same rubric, prefer ASC ’s answer to the base model’s more often than the reverse (22 against 12 of 75 pairs) and GRPO + KL’s (28 against 14; Appendix G ).
Exact match on ASQA stays within one point of the base model for ASC , while the copy penalty loses up to 25 points (Table 2 ).

blocks.en: The gain holds across runs, evaluators and training, and it does not game the copy test. • Runs. Every run of ASC , each seed of each model, has a lower authored error rate than the base model on every corpus. • Evaluators. Two checkers never used in training also find more of ASC ’s authored sentences supported than the base model’s, in all 20 settings under MiniCheck-Flan-T5 and in 19 under AlignScore. With no automatic evaluator at all, the human annotators find 24.8% of ASC ’s sentences unsupported against 33.2% of the base model’s (250 ELI5 questions, Llama-3.1-8B; p = 0.01 p=0.01 ). • Copy test. ASC does not learn to copy just below its threshold: fewer of its authored sentences sit just below it than the base model’s (9.2% against 11.3%), and with the threshold lowered to 0.4, its share of copied sentences stays below the base model’s in every setting (Appendix D.5 ). • Training. ASC does not drift into a shortcut: on every model, its copy share drops within the first quarter of training and then stays flat, and its refusals never exceed the base model’s, whereas plain GRPO ends at a copy share of 72.8 (Finding 2; curves in Figure 7 , Appendix D.6 ).

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we showed that faithfulness rewards for long-form RAG pay for copying, and that common defenses only move this shortcut to shorter, emptier answers and refusals.
We then introduced ASC , which credits only the sentences a model authors, that the question alone does not support and that the passages do, and compares each sentence with every sentence of its group.
On four models, it lowers the authored error rate while writing more grounded sentences, held-out corpora included, without these shortcuts or any loss in answer quality.
More broadly, we suggest asking of any reward what a policy can earn without the behavior it is meant to teach.
A RAG model should be credited for what it writes, not for what it copies.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们展示了对长式RAG的忠诚奖励对抄袭的支付,而普通的辩护只将这条捷径移动到更短,更空洞的答案和拒绝.
随后,我们引入了ASC,它只将句子评为模范作者,问题本身并不支持,段落也支持,并且将每个句子与其组中的每个句子进行比较.
在4个模型上,它降低了作者出错率,同时写出更多有根据的句子,被搁置出公司,没有这些快捷键或答题质量的任何损失.
更广义地说,我们建议要求给予任何奖励,如果政策没有它所要教的行为,它能赚多少。
一个RAG模型应该归功于它写的东西,而不是它复制的东西.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
ASC needs no model beyond the reward’s checker: its copy test matches strings, and its vacuity and support tests reuse the checker.
This keeps the method simple and lets it adopt a stronger checker as one appears, but its tests are only as reliable as that checker, which all methods in our comparison share.
The copy test is lexical, so a close paraphrase counts as authored; ASC writes fewer such near-copies than the base model in 17 of the 20 settings (Appendix D.5 ).
We train models of up to 9B parameters on two training corpora, with one training run for each baseline; the gain holds on all four models and on the three held-out corpora, and we leave larger models to future work.
blocks.zh:
ASC除了检查器之外不需要任何模型:它的复制测试匹配字符串,它的活性和支持测试重复检查器.
这使得方法保持了简单,并让它采用一个看起来更强的检查器,但是它的测试只和这个检查器一样可靠,而这个检查器是我们所有比较中的方法。
复制测试是用词法,所以一个近似词算作作者;ASC在20个设置中的17个(Appendix D.5 .)中写作这种近似复制的比基模型要少.
我们在两个训练团上训练多达9B参数的模型,每个基线都训练一次;所有四个模型和三个被搁置的模型都维持了收益,我们把更大的模型留给今后的工作。

blocks.en:
ASC rewards the grounded sentences a model writes, not declining, so it refuses less than the base model, also on questions the passages do not answer, where the judge prefers the base model’s refusal (Appendix E ).
Pairing ASC with a grounded-refusal objective ( Song et al., 2025 ) is a natural next step.
Finally, ASC targets the reliability of what a model writes itself; where an application prefers verbatim quotation, plain faithfulness rewards already deliver it.
blocks.zh:
ASC奖励一个模型写作的被基于的句子,而不是下降,因此它拒绝的比基准模型少,同样是段落没有回答的问题,法官更喜欢基准模型的拒绝(Appendix E.
将ASC与被禁目的对等(Song等,2025年)是自然的下一步.
最后,ASC以模型本身所写的可靠性为目标;如果一个应用程序更喜欢逐字引用,那么纯粹的忠诚就已经得到了回报。

blocks.en: Sentence tests. ASC and the metrics share three sentence tests; the reward uses only the second. • Copy. Answer and passages are lowercased and split into words. A word of the answer is covered if some window of five consecutive answer words containing it also occurs in the passages, and the copy share is the covered fraction. A sentence is copied if the copy share of its text, with list markers, headings and emphasis stripped, is at least τ = 0.5 \tau=0.5 ; a sentence made only of such markup is neither copied nor authored and earns no credit. • Support. A sentence is supported when the checker’s probability is at least κ = 0.5 \kappa=0.5 . Long passages are split into chunks aligned with sentences, and the maximum over chunks is taken. • Vacuity. A sentence is vacuous when the support check passes with the question in place of the passages, a context ablation in the spirit of conditional mutual information ( van der Poel et al., 2022 ) and SelfCite ( Chuang et al., 2025 ) . Bespoke-MiniCheck-7B ( Bespoke Labs, 2024 ) is the checker of the reward and of ASC ; MiniCheck-Flan-T5-Large ( Tang et al., 2024 ) and AlignScore ( Zha et al., 2023 ) are the held-out checkers, used only in evaluation.

Metrics. The judge, Gemma-4-31B ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) at full precision, reads the passages and one authored sentence (prompt in Appendix H ); a sentence is an error when the judge rejects it outright, with a probability of “Yes” below 3.5 × 10 − 10 3.5\times 10^{-10} .
Its probabilities are nearly binary (46% of sentences below 0.001 and 42% above 0.999), and this rule, chosen on one half of RAGTruth’s human-labeled responses and tested on the other, reaches a balanced accuracy of 0.81 against the human labels, above the 0.75 of the reward’s checker.
Copying counts as a shortcut even though Err leaves copied sentences out: a policy that copies more submits fewer of its own sentences to the judge, so Err can fall without any sentence becoming more reliable, which Supp. makes visible.
An answer refuses only when every sentence declines to answer, so a single hedge is not a refusal.

blocks.en:
Under the reward’s checker, authored sentences are unsupported 1.8 to 8.1 times as often as copied ones for every model and corpus, most on ELI5, where base models write most of the answer themselves.
The held-out checkers find the same gap, MiniCheck-Flan-T5 everywhere and AlignScore in all but one case, so it is not a quirk of one checker: entailment models accept hypotheses that overlap their premise ( McCoy et al., 2019 ) , and a copied sentence overlaps it entirely.
Human span labels on RAGTruth (131,087 sentences, no checker involved) agree: copied sentences carry errors at 1.9% and authored ones at 12.2%, and the error rate falls steadily with copy share, from 13.7% in the lowest decile to 0.6% in the highest.
blocks.zh:

RAGTruth上的人间标签(131,087个句子,没有涉及检查器)同意:复制的句子带有1.9%的错误,编写者有12.2%的错误,错误率随复制份额而稳步下降,从最低的十分位数的13.7%下降到最高的0.6%.

Every policy trained on R R raises the reward through a shortcut rather than through better authored sentences (Table 10 ): authored support rises too, but on fewer authored sentences.
Plain GRPO copies until 81.0% of its answers contain no authored sentence; GRPO + KL refuses and writes emptier answers; DPO copies more even when the two answers of every pair copy equally.
On Llama-3.1-8B, plain GRPO settles on a vacuous template whose most frequent sentences are “A film was made.” and “A song was released.”, which earns a reward of 99.8 at an exact match of 0.5.

blocks.en: C.3 Whole-answer and sentence advantages (Finding 3)
blocks.zh: C.3 全答和句子优势(结论3)

blocks.en: Table 11: How GRPO’s answer-level advantage moves each kind of sentence, on the base-model samples of Finding 1. Kinds, in the order of ASC ’s tests: copied; vacuous (authored, supportable from the question alone); grounded (authored, not vacuous, supported by the reward’s checker); authored, unsupported. Count: sentences of that kind. Up, Down: the answer’s reward is above, below its group’s mean; Unmoved: equal to it, so the advantage is zero. blocks.zh: 表11:GRPO的答题级优势如何在Find 1的基模样本上移动出每一种句子. Kinds,按照ASC测试的顺序:复制;空闲(作者,仅来自问题支持);被基于(作者,而非空闲,由奖励的检查者支持);被作者,不支持. 计数:这种句子. 上,下:答案的分数在上,低于其集团的平分;不动:等于,所以优势为零. 推起,如果移动: 在句子中推出的份额 GPRO 移动,集合 及其范围 模型和公司。

blocks.en:
Signs of GRPO’s advantage. Every sentence takes the sign of its answer’s advantage, so Table 11 counts how GRPO moves each kind of sentence.
It leaves a third of all sentences, and half of the copied ones, unmoved, because their answer’s reward equals the group’s mean; among the sentences it moves, it pushes up copied and grounded ones at nearly the same rate, and most vacuous ones too.
Under ASC , a copied, vacuous or unsupported sentence always takes the lowest advantage of its group (Proposition 1 (ii)), so none is pushed up.
blocks.zh:
GRPO的优势迹象. 每个句子都带有其答案的优点,所以表11计算出GRPO如何移动每一种句子.
它留下了三分之一的句子,一半的被复制的句子没有移动,因为他们的答案等于集团的恶果;在它所移动的句子中,它把复制的和被复制的句子推向了几乎一样的速度,最空虚的句子也一样.
在ASC下,被复制的,空洞的或不支持的句子总是占了组别的最低优势(建议1 (ii)),因此没有被推高.

blocks.en:
Correlation with held-out support. On the same pool as Table 9 (21,970 authored, non-vacuous sentences in 1,967 groups), we compute two advantages from the binary form of the credit in Eq. 3 : GRPO’s answer-level advantage, with the credit summed over the answer, and the sentence advantage of Eq. 5 .
Their correlation with the support of the authored sentences under MiniCheck-Flan-T5 is 0.07 and 0.21: the same credit tracks a sentence’s reliability far more closely when sentences are compared with sentences rather than answers with answers.
Answer length explains less than 2% of the variance of either advantage, so the difference does not come from length.
blocks.zh:
与被搁置支持的关系。 与表9(21,970名作者,1,967个组别中非空置的句子)相同,我们计算了二进制信用在Eq. 3中的两个优势:GRPO的答题水平优势,与答题相比,信用总和,以及Eq. 5的句子优势.
他们与MiniCheck-Flan-T5下作者的判刑支持的关联度为0.07和0.21:当判决与判刑相比较而不是用答案回答时,同样的信用跟踪了判决的可靠性.
答题长度解释两个优势相差不到2%,所以差异不由长度来产生.

blocks.en:
Faithfulness. The one setting in which AlignScore does not confirm the gain of Section 6.4 is a 0.2-point dip (Qwen3.5-9B on ELI5).
The absolute gain is largest where the base model errs most, up to 15.6 points for Llama-3.2-3B on ExpertQA, which is the same relative cut as elsewhere (38%, Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh:
忠诚 AlignScore不确认第6.4节收益的一种设定是0.2分的浸出(在ELI5上的Quen3.5-9B).
绝对增益最大的地方是基模型最出错的地方,在专家QA上的Llama-3.2-3B最高可达15.6分,这与其他地方的相对削减(38%,图5)相同.

blocks.en:
Shortcuts. The baselines’ shortcuts concentrate on ELI5 and ExpertQA, the held-out corpora where the base model errs most and an answer must be written rather than assembled (Section 3 ).
There GRPO + KL declines 44 to 76% of the questions on the Qwen models, against at most 28% on the other corpora, and the copy penalty declines 94 to 95% on Qwen3.5-9B.
On the Llama models, GRPO + KL and the sentence reward copy more than the base model on every corpus, and the copy penalty shortens the answers instead, to 56 to 89% of the base model’s words. ASC does the opposite: it copies less, writes fewer vacuous sentences and refuses less than the base model on every corpus, and writes longer answers on every held-out corpus.
blocks.zh:
快捷键。 基线的捷径集中在ELI5和ExpertQA上,后者是被搁置的公司,基本模型在其中误入歧途,必须写出答案,而不是组装(第3节)。
在那里,GRPO + KL在"Quen"模型上的问题下降了44%到76%,而其他"Corpora"最多下降了28%,而"Quen3.5-9B"的拷贝处罚则下降了94到95%.
在Llama模型上,GRPO + KL 和 句子奖励复制量超过每起诉讼案的基准模型,而副本惩罚则将答案缩短到基准模型词的56%至89%. ASC做的正好相反:它抄写较少,写出较少空洞的句子,拒绝的则少于每个被扣的被扣的被扣的被扣的被扣的被扣的被扣的被扣的被扣的被扣的被扣的基本模型.

blocks.zh: D.2 每个答复和意义

blocks.en:
Err is a rate over authored sentences, and ASC writes more of them, so a lower rate could hide more errors per answer; Table 14 therefore counts them.
Err is lower in every setting, significantly in 14 of the 20.
Per answer, ASC writes 0.3 to 1.0 more judge-supported authored sentences, and its unsupported ones fall in 16 settings and rise significantly in none.
Counting copied sentences too, the unsupported share of the whole answer falls in 18 settings and rises significantly in none, so answers become more faithful as a whole.
Within bins of answer length, ASC still writes more supported authored sentences in all 20 settings, so the added content is not a by-product of length.
blocks.zh:
Err 是一个比作者的句子高的速率, ASC 写得更多, 所以较低的速率可以隐藏每个回答更多的出错; 因此表 14 计算它们.
每个环境的误差都较低,在20个环境中有14个显著。
按回答,ASC写出更多由法官支持的写作句子0.3到1.0,其不支持的句子在16个场合下落下而无显著上升.
也计算被复制的句子,整个答案的不支持份额在18个设置中会下降,在无的情况下会大幅上升,因此答案整体变得更加忠实.
在答题长度的bins内,ASC仍然在所有20个设置中写出更多支持的作者句子,因此所添加的内容不是长度的副产品.

blocks.en: D.4 Robustness of the shortcut rule
blocks.zh: D.4 捷径规则的有力性

blocks.en:
The shortcut rule of Section 6.1 has two free choices, the margin and the word floor, and Table 16 recomputes the ranking of Table 2 under other values of both. ASC is flagged in no setting under any of them.
The number of settings in which it has the lowest Err falls at wider margins, mostly because they stop flagging the sentence reward, which copies a median 3.8 points more than the base model and 14.0 more than ASC .
Without any threshold the picture is the same: in 19 of the 20 settings, no baseline has both a lower Err and at least as many supported authored sentences per answer as ASC ; the exception, the copy penalty on ASQA for Llama-3.2-3B, writes answers half as long.
Where a baseline takes no shortcut, in 5 of its 60 results, ASC ’s error rate is lower in one (Llama-3.1-8B on ExpertQA, 19.9 against 22.5 for GRPO + KL) and no different in the other four, while ASC writes significantly more judge-supported authored sentences in all five (0.4 to 0.8 per answer).
blocks.zh:
第6.1节的快捷规则有两个自由选择,比值和单词下限,而表16则在两者的其他值下重算表2的排名. ASC在任何一种情况下都没有标记。
其设置数量最少 厄尔跌入更宽的边缘,主要是因为他们停止了标出判罚奖励,该奖励复制的中位数为3.8分,比基数多出14.0分。
在20个设置中的19个设置中, 没有一个基线既没有更低的厄尔, 也至少有同样多的 ASC 支持作者的句子; 例外的是,
如果基线不采取捷径,则在其60个结果中的5个结果中,ASC的错误率在1个(Llama-3.1-8B on ExpertQA,19.9对22.5对GRPO + KL)中较低,而在其他4个结果中没有区别,而ASC在所有5个(每个答复0.4到0.8个)中写出更多得到法官支持的写作句子.

blocks.en: D.5 Near-copies
blocks.zh: D.5 近拷贝

blocks.en:
A policy trained against a copy test could learn to copy just below its threshold. Section 6.4 rules this out for verbatim copying (just below: a copy share of 0.40 to 0.50), and with the threshold lowered to 0.4, ASC also keeps its lower error rate.
Beyond verbatim matches, an authored sentence of ASC is as close to its closest passage sentence as one of the base model (median ROUGE-L precision 0.42 for both; Lin, 2004 ), and ASC writes fewer near-copies, with a ROUGE-L of at least 0.8, in 17 of the 20 settings.
Within terciles of closeness, its authored error rate is below the base model’s in 58 of the 60 tercile and setting pairs, so its gain is not a product of closeness.
blocks.zh:
一项针对拷贝测试进行训练的政策可以学会复制到略低于其阈值。 第6.4节将这一点排除于逐字记录(仅下文:0.40至0.50份的复制份额)之外,随着阈值降低到0.4,ASC也保持较低的出错率.
除了逐字记录相配外,ASC的一首作词句也和其最接近的段落句子一样接近于基准模型之一(两者的中间为ROUGE-L精度0.42;Lin,2004年),而ASC所写的近相相复制较少,在20个设置中的17个设置中,ROUGE-L至少为0.8.
在近距离距离内,它的作者出错率低于60分之一中58分的基准模型,因此它的收益不是近距离的产物。

blocks.zh: D.6 培训动态

blocks.en: Figure 7: All four models on ASQA over training (0: base model): GRPO + KL, ASC , and the copy penalty where its intermediate checkpoints were evaluated.
blocks.zh: 图7: " ASQA " 上所有四种模式都高于培训(0:基准模式):GRPO + KL、ASC以及对其中间检查站进行评价的拷贝处罚。

blocks.en:
Figure 7 follows GRPO + KL and ASC through training on every model, and the copy penalty on Qwen3.5-9B and Llama-3.1-8B.
The baselines’ shortcuts build up over training: GRPO + KL’s refusals rise from the first checkpoint on the Qwen models, up to 29% of answers for Qwen3.5-4B, and its copy share rises on the Llama models, while the copy penalty’s answers shrink as its refusals and vacuous share grow.
Their authored support ends at or above ASC ’s, but over the fewer sentences they still write. ASC settles early on every model: its copy share falls within the first quarter of training and then stays flat, its vacuous share falls by mid-training, and it ends with longer answers and fewer refusals than the base model.
blocks.zh:
图7采用GRPO + KL和ASC,通过对每个型号的培训,以及Quen3.5-9B和Llama-3.1-8B的拷贝处罚。
基线的捷径比训练要长: GRPO + KL 的拒绝率从Quen模式上的第一个检查点上升至29%的Qwen3.5-4B,其副本份额在Llama模式上上升,而副本惩罚的答案则随着其拒绝和空闲份额的增长而收缩.
他们的作者支持以ASC为终点, ASC提早解决了每个模型:其拷贝分数属于培训第一季度,然后保持平平,其空闲分数在培训中期后会下降,最后以更长的答案和更少的拒绝率来结束.

blocks.en: Appendix E Answer Quality
blocks.zh: 附录E 答复质量

blocks.en:
Section 6.2 compares whole answers with LLM judges.
This section gives the protocol, how its rubric was chosen without favoring any method, the result in every setting, a second judge, and checks that need no judge preference: reference coverage, refusals and answerable questions.
blocks.zh:
第6.2节将整个答复与LLM法官进行比较。
本节给出了协议,如何在不赞成任何方法的情况下选择其标题,每个设置的结果,第二个法官,以及不需要法官优先的检查:参考范围,拒绝和可回答的问题.

blocks.en:
Protocol. The judge is Gemma-4-31B, the judge of the authored error rate.
It sees the question, the passages and two answers and returns the answer that serves a reader better, or a tie, with a one-sentence reason (prompt in Appendix H ).
Every pair is judged in both orders; a pair is a win only if both orders agree, any other outcome is a tie, and a tie counts half in the win rate.
We compare ASC (first seed) with the base model and each baseline, and each baseline with the base model, on up to 300 questions per setting, about 5,400 pairs each.
blocks.zh:
议定书。 法官为Gemma-4-31B,是作者出错率的法官.
它看到问题,段落和两个答案,并返回一个更适合读者的答案,或者一个平分,一个判决理由(在附录H中提示).
每对均由两种顺序判断;一对只有在两种顺序都同意的情况下才算取胜,任何其他结果都是平分,平分数在取胜率中算入了一半.
将ASC(第一种子)与基准模型和每个基线,以及每个基准与基准模型进行比较,每设定最多300个问题,每组约5400对.

blocks.en: Table 17: Probes (%) for the three candidate rubrics, built from base-model answers only: two biases (copied form, padding) and the sensitivity to a planted error. Rubric 2 (bold) is the one used.
blocks.zh: 表17:仅由基模答案构建的三种候选标点的探测器(%):两种偏差(复制形式,贴花)和对所放置错误的敏感性. rubric 2 (粗体)是使用的一款.

blocks.en:
Choosing the rubric. LLM judges favor longer answers and a fixed position ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) , and a judge that favored quoted or long text would rank methods by style.
We wrote three rubrics and measured each on probes built from base-model answers only (Table 17 ): the same content as a verbatim passage sentence or in the model’s own words (404 pairs), an answer padded with a restated sentence (200 pairs), and an answer with one supported sentence replaced by an unsupported one (153 pairs), which a useful judge must notice.
The rule, fixed in advance, keeps the rubrics that prefer the intact answer at least 80% of the time, takes the one closest to 50% on the copy probe, and breaks near-ties by the smaller preference for padding.
The chosen rubric states that quoting is neither a merit nor a fault and that length is no merit, and counts a refusal as right only when the passages lack the answer; it was fixed, and its hash recorded, before any answer of a trained model was judged.
blocks.zh:
选取道标. LLM评委赞成较长的答案和一个固定的职位(郑等,2023;王等,2024),一位赞成引用或长文本的法官会按风格排列方法.
我们写了三个题材,每个题材都用仅由基模解答(表17)制成的探针测量:内容与逐字记录句相同,或者在模型本身的词中(404对),一个用重写句子(200对)来补充答案,一个用支持句子取而代之的答案被一个不支持句子(153对)所取而代之,一个有用的法官必须注意到.
该规则预先被固定,将偏好完整答案的分数至少保留了80%的时间,取出抄本探针上最接近50%的分数,并被偏好贴花的分数较小的分数所打破.
所选标题指出,引用既不是功绩,也不是过错,长度也不是功绩,只有在段落缺乏答案时,才将拒绝视为正确;在判断一个训练有素的模型的任何答案之前,它是固定的,并记录了它的散列。

blocks.zh: 图8:培训奖励优于基准模式,与(a) 基准模式的赢取率和(b) 法官支持的撰写的每项答复句子的变化相对应。 标记:指间隔为95%的20个设置;光点:每个设置的ASC. 每种方法都提高奖励,但只有ASC保持了基础模型的质量并增加了内容.

blocks.en:
Preference. Table 18 gives every setting. Significant verdicts favor ASC more often than the other method in every comparison: over the base model in 5 settings (the base model in 2), and over the copy penalty, GRPO + KL and the sentence reward in 14, 9 and 3 (each of them in at most 2).
Figure 8 adds the spread over the 20 settings to Table 3 , and the change in supported authored sentences: only ASC adds supported content.
Controlled for length, by a logistic fit of the verdict on the difference in words, its win rates are 48.9% against the base model, 50.1% against GRPO + KL, 54.5% against the copy penalty and 49.2% against the sentence reward; this control also removes the credit for the extra supported sentences, which come with more words, so it likely understates ASC ’s win rates.
A second seed on Qwen3.5-9B gives the same ordering (52.1% and 56.4% against the base model and GRPO + KL).
blocks.zh:
偏爱. 表18给出了每一个设置。 重大判决在每次比较中都比其他方法更倾向于ASC:在5个设置中比基模(基模为2个),在副本处罚中比起GRPO+KL,在14,9和3中比起判罚奖励(每个在最多2个).
图8在表3中增加了20个设置的分布,以及支持的作者句子的变化:只有ASC增加了支持的内容.
从逻辑上看,通过对文字差异的判断,其胜出率为48.9%,对基数模型的胜出率为50.1%,对GRPO + KL的胜出率为54.5%,对副本处罚的胜出率为49.2%,对判刑奖励的胜出率为49.2%;这种控制还取消了额外支持的句子的得分,这些句子的胜出率比较多,因此有可能低估了ASC的胜出率。
Quen3.5-9B上的第二个种子给出相同的订单(以基模和GRPO + KL为对的52.1%和56.4%).

blocks.en:
Second judge. Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct, from a third model family, judges the same pairs with the same rubric and ranks the methods as Gemma does (Table 3 ), although its copy probe shows a bias against ASC (it prefers the copied form in 62.9% of the pairs).
On the pairs that both judges decide, 45% of all pairs, they agree on 81.7% ( κ \kappa 0.61).
blocks.zh:
第二评事. Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct,来自第三个模型家族,以相同的标点判断同一对并按Gemma的方法排序(表3 ),尽管其复制探针显示对ASC的偏好(它更喜欢在62.9%的对等中复制出表格).
在两位法官决定的配对上,45%的配对,他们同意81.7%(\kappa 0.61).

blocks.en:
Reference coverage. ASQA, ClapNQ and ELI5 come with reference answers; the judge splits each reference into key points and checks which ones an answer conveys. ASC covers the most key points on average (Table 3 ), significantly more than the base model in 4 of the 12 settings and less in none.
The NLI model TRUE ( Honovich et al., 2022 ) , which is not an LLM judge, agrees with Gemma on 90.7% of the key points ( κ \kappa 0.80) and gives the same direction (+1.3 points).
blocks.zh:
参考报道. ASQA、ClapNQ和ELI5提供了参考答案;法官将每个参考分为关键点,并检查一个答案传达哪些。 ASC平均涵盖最关键点(表3),大大高于12个设置中4个设置中的基准模型,而零设置中则更少.
NLI模型TRUE(Honovich等,2022年)不是LLM法官,与Gemma就90.7%的关键点(\kappa 0.80)达成一致,给出了相同的方向(+1.3分).

blocks.en:
Refusals. Refusing is right when the passages lack the answer, and the base model mostly refuses for that reason: the judge finds that the passages do not answer 85.4% of its 575 refusals.
GRPO + KL, the sentence reward and ASC also refuse mostly on such questions (79.0%, 93.7% and 88.8% of their refusals), but the copy penalty does not: 47.2% of its 3,821 refusals fall on questions the passages answer fully or in part. ASC answers most of the questions the base model rightly refuses, with an authored error rate of 5.5%, and there the judge prefers the refusal ( ASC wins 32.3% of 181 pairs); where both models answer, ASC wins 51.5%.
blocks.zh:
拒绝 当段落缺少答案时拒绝是正确的,而基模大多出于这个原因拒绝:法官发现段落没有回答其575个拒绝的85.4%.
GRPO + KL,判决奖励和ASC也大多拒绝这类问题(79.0%,93.7%和88.8%的拒绝),但副本处罚没有:其3,821次拒绝中的47.2%是全部或部分回答段落的问题. ASC解答了大部分基础模型正确拒绝的问题,作者错误率为5.5%,在那里法官更喜欢拒绝(ASC赢得了181对中的32.3%);在这两个模型都回答的地方,ASC赢得了51.5%.

blocks.en: Table 19: Base model against ASC on the questions whose passages contain the answer: questions, authored error rate (Err) and supported authored sentences per answer (Supp.). ∗ : a significant difference from the base model (bootstrap over questions, Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 表19:针对包含答案的段落:问题、作者错误率(ERR)和支持作者每个答案的句子(Supp.)的ASC的基础模型。 *:与基准模型的显著区别(对问题的陷阱,附录D)。

blocks.en: Answerable questions. On the questions whose passages contain the answer (labeled by the judge; Mistral agrees on 84% of 300 sampled questions), ASC has a lower error rate than the base model in 19 of the 20 settings and writes significantly more supported authored sentences in all 20 (Table 19 ).
blocks.zh: 可答之问. 关于其段落包含答案的问题(由法官贴上标签;Mistral同意300个抽样问题中的84%),ASC在20个设置中的19个设置的出错率低于基准模型,并在所有20个设置中写出得到显著支持的作者句子(表19).

blocks.en: Appendix F Ablation Details
blocks.zh: 附录F 详细情况

blocks.en: Table 20: Ablations on Qwen3.5-9B on every corpus: authored error rate (Err; grey, bold and underlined as in Table 4 ), copy and vacuous share, and supported authored sentences per answer (Supp.).
blocks.zh: 表20: Quen3.5-9B号楼的损坏情况 每一份表格上:作者出错率(Err;灰色、粗体和下划线,如表4),副本和空闲份额,并支持作者每一份答复的句子(Supp.)。

blocks.en:
Each ablation of Section 6.3 changes one part of ASC on Qwen3.5-9B and keeps every other setting of Appendix B ; the answer-advantage variant sums the graded credit over the answer.
Table 20 gives every corpus.
The vacuity test matters where vacuous sentences are common: without it, Err rises on ASQA, ELI5 and ExpertQA, the three corpora where the base model writes the most vacuous sentences, and falls slightly on RAGTruth and ClapNQ.
Removing the copy test or the graded credit, or using the answer-level advantage, raises Err or brings copying back on at least four of the five corpora.
blocks.zh:
第6.3节的每次修改都修改了Qwen3.5-9B上的ASC的一部分,并保留附录B的所有其他设置;答案-优势变式将分级的信用加在答案之上。
表20给出了所有证据。
活泼测试在空闲的句子常见的地方很重要:没有它,厄尔在ASQA,ELI5和ExpertQA上上升了,基础模型写出最空闲句子的"三蝎子",在RAGTruth和ClapNQ上略有下降.

blocks.en: Appendix G Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录G 人类评价

blocks.en: Two graduate-level annotators experienced in the field label sentences and compare answers, blind to the method that wrote them.
blocks.zh: 两个研究生级的注释员在野外标签句子和比较答案方面经验丰富,对写这些句子的方法视而不见.

blocks.en:
Sentence labels. The annotators label authored sentences as supported or unsupported by the passages.
On a judge-validity set drawn from base-model and trained answers on ASQA and ELI5, the judge agrees with people at least as often on the sentences of ASC (90.8%) as on the base model’s (85.5%), in both model families.
In a direct test with no judge, one random authored sentence from the base model and one from ASC for each of 250 ELI5 questions answered by Llama-3.1-8B, 24.8% of the sentences of ASC are unsupported against 33.2% of the base model’s (exact McNemar p = 0.01 p=0.01 ).
On 150 shared sentences, the annotators agree with a Cohen’s kappa of 0.65.
blocks.zh:
句子标签。 注释者将作者的句子标签为段落支持或不支持.
法官们同意人们对ASC(90.8 % ) 的判刑, 也同意基模(85.5% ) 的判刑。
在没有法官的直接测试中,Llama-31-8B回答的250个ELI5问题中,一个来自基建模型的随机写出句子和一个来自ASC的句子,24.8%的ASC的句子对33.2%的基建模型没有支持(准确的 McNemar p = 0.01 p = 0.01).
在150个共同的句子上, 注释者同意科恩的0.

blocks.en:
Answer preference. The annotators compare 150 pairs of answers, 75 of ASC against the base model and 75 against GRPO + KL, drawn with a fixed seed across the four models and five corpora; the order of the two answers is random, and they follow the rubric of Appendix E .
Counting a tie as half a win, they prefer ASC to the base model in 56.7% of the pairs and to GRPO + KL in 59.3%.
They agree with a Cohen’s kappa of 0.66, and on the pairs where both decide, their verdict matches Gemma’s in 89.8% and Mistral’s in 88.9%.
blocks.zh:
回答偏爱。 注释者比较了150对答案,75对ASC对基准模型和75对GRPO + KL,取出一个固定的种子横跨了4个模型和5个蝎子;两个答案的顺序是随机的,它们遵循了附录E的标题.
将平局算作半胜,他们更喜欢在56.7%的对子中ASC取而代之的基型,在59.3%中取而代之的是GRPO + KL.
他们同意科恩的0.66卡帕, 以及双方决定的对等,

blocks.en: Appendix I Example Answers
blocks.zh: 附录一

blocks.en:
Examples 1–4 show one question for each model, two from training corpora and two from held-out ones, answered by all five policies of Table 2 .
Each example is chosen to be representative of its setting.
Among the questions whose passages and five answers fit in one box, and which the base model answers without declining any part, we take the one whose answers best show each policy’s typical behavior in that setting (Appendix D ): ASC copies no more than the base model and writes more grounded sentences, as it does at the median, and as many baselines as one question allows take their most frequent shortcut there.
Each box gives the question, every passage as the model saw it, and the five answers.
In the passages, highlighted text is repeated verbatim, five words or more, by at least one answer, so the copied material is visible at a glance.
In the answers, every sentence is marked as copied C , authored and supported A , authored and unsupported U or vacuous V (supported or not under the judge; vacuous under the reward’s checker), and ASC ’s answer is shaded.
blocks.zh:
例子1-4显示了每个模式的一个问题,其中两个来自培训公司,两个来自被搁置的公司,由表2的所有五个政策回答。
每个例子均选取来代表其背景。
在哪些问题,其段落和五个答案合为一个框,而基准模型在不减少任何部分的情况下回答的问题中,我们采取最能说明每个政策在这一背景下的典型行为(附录D): ASC只复制基准模型,写出更有底线的句子,就像它在中位线上所做的那样,而且只要一个问题允许用它们最频繁的捷径。
每个盒子都给出问题,模型所看到的每一个段落,以及五个答案.
在段落中,被突出的文字是重复的逐字记录,五字或以上,至少一个答案,所以被复制的材料可以一目了然地看到.
在回答中,每个句子被标记为被复制的C,作者和支持的A,作者和不支持的U或空闲V(支持或不在法官之下;在赏金检查器下空闲),ASC的答案被遮蔽.

blocks.en:
In Example 1, the base model copies its first two sentences and adds an unsupported claim about the Qt toolkit; GRPO + KL keeps the two copied sentences and the sentence reward copies a third, and the copy penalty declines the question, as it does on 95.4% of ELI5 questions for Qwen3.5-9B. ASC conveys the same content in its own words, in four grounded sentences, with no error.
In Example 2, GRPO + KL and the sentence reward copy two and three of their three sentences, the copy penalty ends on a vacuous one, and ASC copies one of its four sentences and grounds the other three.
In Example 3, the base model overstates the passage (California taxes no lottery winnings at all), GRPO + KL and the copy penalty decline a question the passage answers, the sentence reward opens with a copied sentence, and ASC writes four grounded sentences, including the federal withholding rules.
In Example 4, GRPO + KL and the sentence reward shrink the answer to one copied sentence and the copy penalty to a vacuous one; ASC writes three grounded sentences.
blocks.zh:
在例一中,基模复制了前两句并增加了对Qt工具包的不支持的主张;GRPO + KL保留了被复制的两句并赏罚为第三分,而拷贝罚则拒绝了这个问题,就像对Quen3.5-9B95.4%的ELI5问题所做的那样. ASC用自己的话来传达相同的内容,用四个有底句来表达,没有出错.
在例2中,GRPO + KL和判罚奖励复制了他们的三句中的两句和三句,拷贝惩罚以空出一句结束,ASC复制了它的四句中的一句并证明其他三句是正确的.
在例3中,基数模型过分夸大了通过(加利福尼亚州税完全没有彩票中奖),GRPO + KL并拷贝处罚会拒绝一个对通过答案的质疑,句子奖励会以抄袭的句子开启,ASC写出四个有根据的句子,包括联邦扣分规则.
在例4中,GRPO + KL和句子奖励将答案收缩到一个被复制的句子上,而拷贝惩罚则收缩到一个空闲的句子上;ASC写了三个有根据的句子.
